[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Public-Key Lookup Cache — UAT (U1–U5) + per-key-emitter regression root-cause + emitter-restore fix
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1214
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/494
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/469
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/470
  
  Details:
  Executed UAT for the Public-Key Lookup Cache plan (PR1–PR5) against the freshly-deployed truesight_autopilot (1254da2) and root-caused a new, DAO-wide regression.
  
  UAT U1–U5 RESULTS (2026-09-15, vs deployed service):
  - U1 (per-key file exists & correct): PASS w/ coverage gap — sampled files correct, but only 84% of governor keys have a per-key file (63/75; Gary missing 12).
  - U2 (new key recognised immediately): PASS (code-path) — exercised deployed resolve_key_fresh; recovers a poisoned-cache key, unknown key -> clean None.
  - U3 (revoked key denied): PASS — non-ACTIVE (VERIFYING) files present; deny path exercised.
  - U4 (enumeration intact): PASS — load_governors() -> 73 governor keys, updated_at 2026-09-15.
  - U5 (generation does not grow with unchanged keys): FAIL.
  
  U5 ROOT CAUSE (regression): PR1 (tokenomics#359) + PR2 (#361) added the per-key emitter on 2026-06-16; migration commit 50999ec ("flatten clasp_mirrors/ into google_app_scripts/<scriptId>/") landed the same evening and DELETED it with no rename destination, rewriting the repo to the then-deployed GAS state (pre-PR1). The emitter never ran in production: per-key store frozen since 2026-06-18, every dao_members.json refresh since (through 2026-09-15) touches 0 per-key files, and an org-wide code search finds no re-homed emitter. This is the shared root cause of the Elizabeth Wong per-key roles drift (reframed from one-off to systemic symptom), and it degrades PR4's force-fresh path to the TTL-cached monolith for keys with no per-key file (the ~5-min lag returns for those keys).
  
  DELIVERABLES:
  - tokenomics#494 (open, unmerged): restore the 3 dropped helpers + per-key/manifest build block verbatim from the pre-migration blob, plus a tree-SHA no-op guard; node --check green on all 8 project .js. GAS deploy is gate:human (NOT deployed).
  - agentic_ai_context#1214 (merged): plan §5/§6 UAT results + regression write-up; OPEN_FOLLOWUPS new entry + Elizabeth Wong reframe; HANDOFF_MANIFEST row set to blocked; index regenerated.
  
  Also recorded a tooling meta-bug: the auto-advance directive reads the plan from a TTL-refreshed on-box clone and repeatedly quotes a stale unit.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
